beats.text: Standard RLHF entangles the model in an unstable reinforcement loop, constantly drifting from its original policy while chasing an estimated scalar reward.

beats.text: DPO pivots the problem by mapping the reward function to an optimal policy in closed-form, removing the need for a separate reward model.
